messages:
gina: quick note: spotted brief cross-tenant rows after fast org toggle in Console (C -> D -> C). small repro below.

gina: repro: sign in as D, switch to C quickly, open saved filters. sometimes you see C filters while still scoped to D for ~1-2s.

gina: gateway trace: cache lookup used key=console:filters:<empty-org>, downstream returned rows.owner_org=C, served to user in D.

omar: sounds like cache key generation happened before canonical org was injected on fallback. which PR touched prefetch cache?

gina: prefetch-change PR #6101 moved key generation earlier. I can reproduce locally with artificial matcher delay.

lee: mitigation: 1) compute cache key from incoming X-Canonical-Org at gateway entry 2) strip any X-Owner-* headers from downstream responses 3) emit metric pref.server_org_mismatch when payload.owner_org != request.org.

omar: I'll do the cache-key fix + unit tests. lee add scrub middleware in services.

sre-bot: alert: pref.server_org_mismatch > 0 on staging (3 events).

gina: owners: omar (gateway), lee (service scrub), I'll own e2e and comms. plan: canary staging -> 30m stress -> promote if zero.

omar: opened PR and running staging canary now.

gina: thanks. tagging security for review.
